title: A Never Ending Purpose
verse: Therefore go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit,
observation: We have a never-ending purpose. This purpose given to us by Jesus does not fade with time, failure, or success. We must always be about the Father’s business of being ambassadors of reconciliation. This purpose does not change and we can all do it. We live to know God and to help Him be known among others. This is what it means to make disciples. A good definition of a disciple is to have all of Christ in all of life. We have an endless supply of purpose, joy, difficulty, and calling. This adventure always has one more twist and one more surprise along the way. We never give up on people, because God never gave up on us. We may get weary, but we keep on. We may experience loss, but we keep on. The King is worthy of nothing less.
application: Share your faith with someone today.
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for making disciples out of us so we can share what we have found with others.
